description: After a Turin court cancels Lidia Poët's admission to the bar because she is a woman, she refuses to stop practicing and begins solving cases unofficially through her brother Enrico's law office. A murdered ballerina, an accused anarchist, a family confession, a suspicious death after a séance and other cases sharpen her methods while journalist Jacopo draws her into both investigation and romance. Her appeal against disbarment grows alongside the cases, turning each victory into part of a larger fight for the right to practice law.

s01e01.description: When a ballerina turns up dead, her alleged stalker is accused of murder. Desperate, the suspect's mother turns to Italy's first female lawyer for help.

s01e02.description: Much to Enrico's chagrin, Lidia agrees to defend an anarchist accused of murder. But the scandal goes deeper than she expected and lands her in trouble.

s01e03.description: Lidia and Enrico discover some family secrets when, in an opioid haze, a man from Lidia's past confesses to patricide in her childhood home.

s01e04.description: A woman very similar to Lidia — educated, underestimated, scorned — is on trial. Lidia wants to represent her, but is she too invested to see the truth?

s01e05.description: After a seance at a wild party, a wealthy businessman mysteriously expires, and the most likely suspect has been locked in an asylum for years.

s01e06.description: Lidia uncovers a conspiracy and faces a choice: Should she stay and make her way in a place that doesn't want her, or seek her fortune elsewhere?
